proposals.evidence: DEDR 1395 attests Tamil kaṟuppu, Malayalam kaṟuppu, Kannada/Tulu kappu blackness and Kodagu karatë black. The selected simple colour stems and past-adjectival forms fit that family; divergent or compound responses remain outside it. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These neighbouring survey lects show the same full v/b-initial, r-medial firewood stem, with voiced, unvoiced or weakened medial stop and source-final central vowel preserved; this is a comparative placement, with local inheritance versus contact still open for review. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
